name: Ogura Miki
source:
She is a serious and strict member of the public morals committee. She is meticulous and has a strong sense of justice, and hates senselessness and sloppiness. 

For this reason, she has a strong aversion to men who are uncivilized and dirty. She has a reputation as an honor student who behaves in a disciplined manner to set a good example for other students.

She is always harsh and dismissive to the protagonist who is a slovenly male student. 

Hypnosis brings out her tightly closed sexual desires...?

[Translated from [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/saimin_wonderful/index.htmll]official website[/url]]
